THE_GOLD_COIN_ROOM.title: The Gold Coin
THE_GOLD_COIN_ROOM.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
You come into a room with a golden coin.
When flipped, it will double on heads, but be destroyed on tails.
Do you risk it?
THE_GOLD_COIN_ROOM.pages.TAKEN.descripti: You pocket the coin and leave the room a bit richer.
THE_GOLD_COIN_ROOM.pages.DOUBLED.descrip: You double the gold! But perhaps there is more to win...
GOLD_GOLD_GOLD.title: Gold Gold Gold
GOLD_GOLD_GOLD.pages.INITIAL.description:
A mysterious merchant grins at you from behind a pile of locked cases.

Twenty-one gold. That's all it takes. Who knows what treasures await inside?
GOLD_GOLD_GOLD.pages.INITIAL.options.OPE: Lose [gold]21 Gold[/gold]. Obtain a random reward.
GOLD_GOLD_GOLD.pages.OPENED.description: The lock clicks open. The merchant smiles as you discover your reward.
GOLD_GOLD_GOLD.pages.LEFT.description: You decide to keep your gold. The merchant shrugs.
